headline: Last session: Sensex and Nifty recovered supported by banking and IT stocks, extending a 4-week rally.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Wednesday, 25 November.

why: Record FII buying helped Indian equity benchmarks achieve 9-month highs.
Banking and IT stocks supported market recovery during the last session.
Global AI selloff and hawkish Fed rate signals briefly weighed on market sentiment earlier in the week.
Auto and banking sectors led earlier mid-week surges of nearly 1,000 points on Sensex.
whatHappening: NIFTY50 and SENSEX extended their winning streak to four consecutive weeks with 3% gains.
NIFTY Smallcap 100 underperformed compared to the benchmark indices over the week.
NSE stock price rallied 5% on high trading volume, rising 35% from its October low.
Patanjali cow ghee sample failed food safety testing in Madhya Pradesh.
summary: On the last trading session, Indian markets recovered as banking and IT stocks provided support following an initial dip. The benchmark indices Nifty50 and Sensex extended their winning streak to four weeks, posting 3% weekly gains and reaching 9-month highs driven by record FII inflows. The stock market is closed today due to the weekend and will reopen on Wednesday, 25 November.
